canonical_project: Google Project Raspberry / Botetourt County campus
aliases: Google Project Raspberry / Botetourt County campus
status_as_of_cutoff: County-approved land-use and performance-agreement framework; Virginia DEQ water and air applications remained under review. County says first grading applications were received in February 2026, but a construction start was not independently verified.

actions.result_status: Approved zoning ordinance amendment after an advertised public hearing; data centers were added as a use in the RAM district. County page describes the vote as unanimous.
actions.access_caveat: County summary is the accessible official record; the agenda packet is separately linked in the official Agenda Center.
actions.evidence_note: This is a land-use action, not a building permit.

actions.result_status: EDA approved the Google performance agreement, according to the county's project page.
actions.access_caveat: County project page reports the action; a separate EDA minutes packet was not located.
actions.evidence_note: Performance agreement is not a construction permit.

actions.action_type: tax / economic-development agreement and public land transaction
actions.result_status: Board approved supporting performance-agreement action; county announced purchase of approximately 312 acres for the project. The signed agreement identifies Tax Map Parcel 88(26)3 and approximately 312.55 acres.
actions.access_caveat: The county's announcement and agreement are accessible; the agenda/minutes page does not expose a separate vote tally in the accessible text.
actions.evidence_note: Parcel/access record and development agreement; not a building permit.

actions.result_status: DEQ received a Joint Permit Application including a Virginia Water Protection application; Request 25-1919 was under review as of the cutoff.
actions.access_caveat: Official DEQ project page was readable through the agency page; no final permit decision was posted by the cutoff.
actions.evidence_note: Environmental application under review, not an approval or construction permit.

actions.result_status: County project page says the first grading-permit applications were received in February 2026; the page does not publish permit numbers or a final issuance decision.
actions.access_caveat: County summary does not identify individual permit files; no separate public permit record was located.
actions.evidence_note: Grading application intake is not proof of a building permit, certificate of occupancy, or energized facility.

actions.result_status: DEQ received a Minor NSR permit application for Project Raspberry; Request 21819-1 was under review.
actions.access_caveat: No final air permit decision was posted on the project page by the cutoff.
actions.evidence_note: Air-permit application, not building approval or energization.

actions.result_status: Commission voted 4-1 to set aside discussion of an investigative hearing during July and consider it further in August. The county says it did not endorse or authorize a public hearing at this meeting.
actions.access_caveat: Official mobile news page is the accessible summary; the full minutes were not located.
actions.evidence_note: Procedural discussion; not a project approval or water permit.

actions.result_status: Commission voted unanimously to ask the Board of Supervisors to authorize a public forum on water, power, and sound; it also directed a water-situation summary, infrastructure/accountability request, white paper, and questions. This was a request for Board action, not the forum authorization itself.
actions.access_caveat: Official category/news page is accessible; a standalone article URL and full minutes were not located.
actions.evidence_note: Utility/water governance action; not a construction permit.
